cause: the unit runs `python3 -m room.station --device hw:0` from /home/bee, where an old hand checkout of room/ (no --device flag) sits; with -m the working directory comes first on sys.path, so the old checkout wins over the release in /opt/room-release on PYTHONPATH and every start fails with "unrecognized arguments: --device"
cures_ok: a drop-in setting WorkingDirectory to the release (or /), daemon-reload, restart
move the stale checkout /home/bee/room aside (mv, reversible) and restart
